figures.label: Stocky / larger build (кабанчик)
figures.description: Short-to-average height with a heavy, round torso: chest and waist close in girth (small or negative drop), thick neck, solid thighs. Off-the-rack clothing graded up from a size-40 sample tends to run short in front, tight across the stomach, and low in the rise.

figures.label: Big and tall
figures.description: Larger build at 185 cm or taller. Shares most stocky-build fit problems; jacket length and sleeve length become the second constraint.

figures.label: Athletic / V-shaped
figures.description: Large chest-to-waist drop (15 cm or more). Slim-fit garments pull at the chest and thighs while fitting the waist.

figures.label: Slim
figures.description: BMI under 21. No bundled rule set yet; run `extract` over the corpus to grow one.

figures.label: Average
figures.description: None of the other figures apply. No bundled rule set yet; run `extract` over the corpus to grow one.
